quarterly_data.quarter: Siltronic press release: Wafer demand supports 2026 sales outlook (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 sales were EUR 628.1 million versus EUR 674.8 million in H1 2025, a decrease of 6.9 percent, as higher wafer area sold was offset by negative FX effects (average EUR/USD 1.17 versus 1.09) and the closure of the SD production line; without these two effects, group sales would have been slightly above H1 2025. H1 EBITDA was EUR 134.5 million (H1 2025: EUR 164.6 million), an EBITDA margin of 21.4 percent (H1 2025: 24.4 percent); net profit was EUR -130.0 million (H1 2025: EUR 18.8 million).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 sales EUR 628.1 million (H1 2025: EUR 674.8 million), -6.9 percent; EBITDA EUR 134.5 million, margin 21.4 percent (H1 2025: 24.4 percent); net profit EUR -130.0 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Siltronic press release: Wafer demand supports 2026 sales outlook (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 gross margin declined to -6.4 percent from 17.0 percent in H1 2025, primarily due to significantly higher depreciation related to the expansion of production capacities in Singapore (H1 2026: EUR 238.8 million; H1 2025: EUR 126.1 million). Net payments for capital expenditure were EUR 155.8 million in H1 2026 (H1 2025: EUR 250.1 million) against capitalized additions of EUR 86.0 million; capex in the financial year continues to focus on production capacity expansions in Singapore plus steady-state capex.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 gross margin -6.4 percent (H1 2025: 17.0 percent); depreciation EUR 238.8 million (H1 2025: EUR 126.1 million); capex payments EUR 155.8 million (H1 2025: EUR 250.1 million); additions EUR 86.0 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Siltronic press release: Wafer demand supports 2026 sales outlook (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Executive Board outlook for 2026: the company expects a significant increase in wafer area sold compared with the previous year, and capacity utilization for 300 mm wafers is expected to remain at a high level throughout the year; H1 300 mm volume was driven by strong demand for memory and logic applications, also supported by the capacity expansion in Singapore. Expectations for depreciation, EBIT, capex and net cash flow remain unchanged.
